coordinateContract.rectangles: left/top/right/bottom are world-space edges; interaction x/y are centers and width/height are extents unless authored manifest says otherwise
coordinateContract.dorm: background source 941x1672 is uniformly scaled by 0.5 then offset by DORM_HUB_MAP_OFFSET_X. Flat collision/interaction/spawn fields are already transformed. Source fields also preserved in constants.
coordinateContract.campus: manifest.walkability preserved byte-for-byte as parsed JSON. Do not substitute rectangular collisions or mix north-up campus and loop coordinates.
coordinateContract.qizhen: four source-sized north-up zones; select onFootCollisions or kayakCollisions by vehicle. Dynamic gate/phase semantics require controller logic.
coordinateContract.chapter4: Preserve source layout/topology coordinateSystem; floor local coords and conditional collisionProfiles/physicalDeltas/dynamicGates must be applied by native controller, not flattened blindly.

source.worldScale: single 4516px x 3420px north-up top-down campus plate; separated road and water alpha layers seed the conservative walkability mask
